map.由波速、源频率、观察者速度与波源速度，按 f' = f(v+v_o)/(v-v_: Compute the observed frequency shift from wave speed, source frequency and the velocities of observer and source with f' = f(v+v_o)/(v−v_s).
map.声速约 343 m/s（20℃空气）；波源靠近观察者时频率升高。: Sound speed is about 343 m/s (air at 20°C); frequency rises as the source approaches the observer.
map.声源/观察者相对运动时的频率变化。: Frequency change when source/observer move relative to each other.
map.解释救护车由远及近时警笛音调升高的现象。: Explains why an ambulance siren rises in pitch as it approaches.
map.声速 340 m/s、f=1000 Hz、声源以 20 m/s 朝观察者 → f: Sound speed 340 m/s, f=1000 Hz, source moving toward observer at 20 m/s → f'=f·v/(v-vs)=1000·340/320≈1062.5 Hz.
map.远离频降（红移），靠近频升（蓝移）。: Receding lowers frequency (redshift); approaching raises it (blueshift).
map.光也有多普勒效应吗？: Does light also have the Doppler effect?
map.有，但需用相对论公式处理，与声波公式不同。: Yes, but it requires relativistic formulas, different from the acoustic one.
